_meta.description: ContractIQ ML model configuration. All paths are project-relative. The inference layer resolves the model in this order: final (fine-tuned) -> baseline (pretrained) and clearly reports which one is active.
_meta.disclaimer: AI-assisted analysis. Results should be reviewed by a qualified professional.

baseline_model.license_note: Attribution required; recorded here and in reports/phase3_model_selection.md
baseline_model.selection_reason: Best CPU throughput of the candidates (4.43 win/s vs 3.41 for DistilBERT-squad), half the size, trained for SQuAD2 no-answer behaviour, and uses the same BERT-uncased wordpiece vocabulary as the Phase 2 prepared features.

final_model.expected_origin: GPU fine-tune of the baseline model via ml/src/train.py (see README commands)
final_model.trained_on: CUAD train split (367 contracts), 15 enabled clauses

training.data: Phase 2 train features: 5,105 positive + 15,315 sampled no-answer windows (ratio 1:3)

decoding.note: Calibrated on the validation split (41 contracts, fine_tuned); never tuned on the official test set.

retrieval.measured_recall_note: Aggregate gold-answer recall 95.2% at K=15 on validation (reports/phase3_retrieval_recall.*).
retrieval.full_document_reason: TF-IDF gold-answer recall below the 95% acceptance bar for these clauses (62-93%); they fall back to full-document inference to avoid answer loss.

quantization.rejected_because: Dynamic INT8 measured only 1.24x faster than FP32 and changed the argmax best span on 56% of benchmark windows (mean |delta confidence| = 0.0126); correctness risk outweighs the modest gain.
